title: Triterpene Extraction Protocol from Synechocystis sp. PCC6803
author: Maximilian Dietsch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.mspc6dn

steps.title: Collect and Store Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the volumetric equivalent of OD [750] 20 cell culture, pellet the cells, and discard the medium supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Store the pellet in freezer at -80°C in lobind reaction tubes.
Prepare a solvent control without pellet by mimicking the pellet with an equivalent amount of water or medium.

steps.title: Extract Triterpenes with Acetone
steps.instruction: Resuspend the frozen pellet in 1 ml Acetone containing a total of 10 nmol β-sitosterol (internal standard).

substeps.instruction: Add acetone directly to the frozen pellet immediately after removal from the freezer.
Incubate for 15 min at 50°C under gentle agitation.

steps.title: Separate Solvent Extract
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 1780 rcf for 3 min to separate the pellet from the solvent extract.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the solvent to new 5 ml reaction tubes.
If the pellet is not discolored (blue for Synechocystis), repeat the acetone extraction and combine both solutions in the same tube.

steps.title: Prepare for Liquid-Liquid Extraction
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml 1 M NaCl to the combined acetone solution and mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.9 ml n-Hexane and vortex for 30 sec, alternating between vertical and horizontal vortexing to ensure vigorous mixing.
Centrifuge shortly (e.g., 1 min at 1780 g) for clean phase separation.
Transfer the hexane phase to 2 ml reaction tubes.
Repeat the extraction of the pellet with another 0.9 ml n-Hexane to increase yield and combine both hexane phases in the same tube, avoiding contamination from the NaCl-containing lower phase.

steps.title: Dry Hexane Phase
steps.instruction: Evaporate the hexane phase to dryness as briefly as possible.

substeps.instruction: Use a Speed vac (30°C fast program, approx. 20 min), a rotation evaporator, or an N2-stream.

steps.title: Resuspend and Store Extracts
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried extract in 150 µl Chloroform/MeOH (2:1) containing BHT.

substeps.instruction: Use a pre-prepared stock of Chloroform/MeOH (2:1) with BHT; do not add MeOH and Chloroform separately.
Transfer the resuspension into an HPLC vial with an insert.
